methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 widely searched portable and stationary air compressor models spanning pancake, hot-dog, twin-stack, and vertical-tank form factors from eight brands. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (California Air Tools, Makita, Metabo HPT, DeWalt, Industrial Air) and US retailer/spec sheets (WebstaurantStore, eindustrialsolutions.com, Summit Racing, Home Depot, Lowes). Adversarial pass corrected three USD prices that the draft sourced from Adam Tools / Adam's Tarp & Tool, a Canadian retailer pricing in CAD (DeWalt DCC2560T1, plus source-host fixes for Bostitch and Metabo HPT). tank_capacity_gal and scfm_at_90psi are numeric and unitless; max_psi numeric; noise_dba numeric; motor_hp numeric (rated/running HP where published, else null); power_source is 'corded'|'cordless'|'gas'; pump_type is 'oil_free'|'oiled'. priceUsd reflects a confirmed published US retail price; null where no US price could be confirmed. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Makita MAC210Q Quiet Series 2-Gallon Oil-Free Compressor
products.priceNote: Tool Nut US retail $379.00 (JSON-LD Offer price 379.00 USD, InStock, compare-at equal so no markdown). Makita does not publish an online MSRP for the MAC210Q.
products.provenance: Verified on the Makita official product page (makitatools.com/products/details/MAC210Q), whose spec table lists this exact model — "Quiet Series 1 HP, 2 Gallon, Oil-Free, Electric Air Compressor" (UPC 088381-897501): Tank 2 gal., Maximum Pressure 135 PSI, Performance (90 PSI) 2 CFM, Motor/Running Horsepower 1 HP, Pump Type Oil-Free, 60 dB. Model identity is unambiguous (2-gallon MAC210Q, not the 1-gal MAC100Q or 3-gal MAC320Q) and is corroborated on Tool Nut, which sells SKU MAC210Q with the identical spec copy (60 dB, 2 CFM at 90 PSI, 135 PSI max, 1 HP induction motor, oil-free dual-piston, 2 Gallon). Price $379.00 comes from Tool Nut's structured data (Offer price 379.00 USD, InStock); Makita publishes no online MSRP. Note: makitatools.com rejects Node's fetch at the TLS layer, so the manufacturer page was harvested verbatim via curl (raw HTML, no paraphrase) — but every spec value and the price also appear verbatim on the Tool Nut page, which is re-fetchable by the deterministic gate.

products.name: Ridgid OF60150HB 6-Gallon 150 PSI Pancake Compressor
products.priceNote: No single stable US price could be sourced from a fetched page. AirCompressorA's review text states the OF60150HB "retails for around $199 by itself or $299 as part of a combo kit" and that "Amazon currently lists the Ridgid pancake compressor for $165 for the standalone unit or $260 for the full combo kit." Wide spread across sellers/configs, so kept null. (The official RIDGID and Home Depot pages returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched to confirm a list price.)
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed as OF60150HB on both fetched pages: the AirCompressorA spec table (Model # OF60150HB) and the Toolstash spec sheet (Model Number OF60150HB) both describe a 6-gallon steel horizontal-tank pancake compressor, 150 PSI max, 2.6 SCFM @ 90 PSI, oil-free/oil-less pump, corded electric (120V, 12A). AirCompressorA additionally lists a 1.5 HP motor (Toolstash omits HP, no conflict). The official RIDGID (ridgid.com) and Home Depot product pages both returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched, so all specs were sourced verbatim from these two independent pages. noise_dba was left null because the two sources disagree (AirCompressorA lists 84 dBA vs Toolstash 80 dBA) and no authoritative page could be fetched to break the tie. priceUsd left null: the only price figures on a fetched page are AirCompressorA's soft review-narrative range (~$199/$299 at home-improvement stores; ~$165/$260 on Amazon), too wide to set a confident value.

products.name: Senco PC1010 1/2 HP 1-Gallon Portable Compressor
products.priceNote: Manufacturer MSRP $205.00 (senco.com/senco-tool/pc1010/); JMP Wood US retail $204.69
products.provenance: Manufacturer page (senco.com/senco-tool/pc1010/) confirms the exact model — Item #: PC1010, "1/2 HP, 1 Gallon Finish & Trim Air Compressor" — with a full spec table: 1-gallon tank, "Max Pressure: 135 psi", "Air Consumption: .7 SCFM", "Power Type: Corded", 4-amp draw, "Runs at 68 dBA", oil-free pump; it lists "MSRP $205.00". The JMP Wood retailer page corroborates the identical spec table (135 psi, Corded, .7 SCFM, 68 dBA, 1/2 HP, oil-free) and a matching street price of $204.69, confirming this is the PC1010 and not the PC1010N panel sibling. scfm_at_90psi is left null because both pages state ".7 SCFM" as air consumption without tying it to 90 psi; motor_hp 0.5 comes verbatim from "1/2 HP" and priceUsd 205 from the manufacturer MSRP.
